your_games.title: GTA 6
your_games.body: A leaker called CyberLeek says they'll post a full build of the game unless their demands are met. Rockstar also revealed six radio stations, including a metal station hosted by Tom Araya and Kerry King from Slayer. Still due 19 Nov on PS5 and Xbox.

your_games.title: Witcher 3
your_games.body: Patch 5.01 is live. On PS5 it stops your settings resetting every launch, fixes the frame rate caps on the base PS5, and adds bloom and depth-of-field options.

your_games.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
your_games.body: A hotfix stops world saves from vanishing. Update 1.0.1 comes next week and should bring back lost worlds and compensate players whose characters got corrupted.

your_games.title: Pokémon
your_games.body: Pokémon HOME 4.1.0 adds one-way FireRed and LeafGreen transfers, and you get a Celebi for completing the Kanto Pokédex. Flareon and Jolteon join Pokémon UNITE on 13 Oct.

your_games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
your_games.body: Paramount is making a live-action movie with CD Projekt Red. Edgerunners season 2 hits Netflix later this month.

your_games.title: Red Dead Online
your_games.body: The Halloween event is on, and the Dead of Night mode is back.

your_games.title: PS Plus
your_games.body: October's monthly games are F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2, claimable until 2 Nov.

industry.title: Console sales slump
industry.body: PlayStation hardware sales in the US are down 25% this year, the lowest since 2013, and Xbox is down 33%. Rising prices seem to be the main reason.

industry.title: Switch 2: GTA 6 and MW4
industry.body: Nintendo won't confirm GTA 6 for Switch 2, but confirmed Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is coming to it.

industry.title: Xbox launches XP
industry.body: Xbox launched XP, a new film, TV and theme-park division.

releases.title: Valor Mortis
releases.note: A Soulslike from the Ghostrunner team

releases.title: Enshrouded 1.0
releases.note: Survival crafting, worth a look if you like Valheim

footer_note: Helldivers 2 update 7.2 is still expected in October, but there's no official date yet.
